about.title: About Me
about.content:
I am a Bachelor's student in Software Engineering, currently in the final phase of graduation, with graduation expected in September 2026. Passionate about technology, web development and tech education, I have experience as a computer instructor, working on lesson planning and delivery, academic support and monitoring student development in different areas of technology.

I have knowledge in Web Development using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js and Angular, as well as notions of languages such as Java, Python and C#. I am also familiar with databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle and SQL Server.

Throughout my journey, I have developed important skills such as communication, teamwork, leadership, creativity and problem solving, always seeking to combine technical knowledge with a practical, innovative and didactic approach.
